courses.title: Learning GitHub Actions: Event-Driven Automation for Your Codebase
courses.why: Current and short (Michael Jenkins): workflows, events, CI/CD pipelines and custom actions, which is the CI/CD half of this path and of every project brief.

courses.title: Learning Terraform
courses.why: The shortest full Terraform course on LinkedIn Learning (Josh Samuelson). It is from 2022, but the core workflow (providers, state, plan and apply, modules) has not changed; it is also good preparation for the Terraform Associate exam below.

courses.title: Develop Serverless Applications on Cloud Run
courses.updated: Updated about a year ago (per the course page)
courses.why: LinkedIn Learning has no current Cloud Run course. This official one covers Cloud Run with Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub and API gateways, and finishing its challenge lab earns a Google Cloud skill badge. Check its credit cost before starting: the free tier gives monthly credits, otherwise it needs a subscription.

portals.name: Cloud Run quickstarts (official)
portals.what: Deploy a service in your language from source or a container, then try jobs and functions; the fastest hands-on refresher.

portals.name: HashiCorp Terraform tutorials: get started on GCP
portals.what: Official step-by-step Terraform tutorials against Google Cloud (an AWS track is at /terraform/tutorials/aws-get-started).

portals.name: GitHub Skills (GitHub Learn)
portals.what: Free interactive courses that run inside a GitHub repository, including Hello GitHub Actions and testing and deploying with Actions.

portals.name: roadmap.sh DevOps roadmap
portals.what: A map of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, cloud providers and observability to check your coverage; roadmap.sh also has AWS and Terraform roadmaps.

portals.name: DevOps exercises (GitHub)
portals.what: A large open collection of interview questions and exercises on cloud, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD and more.

assessments.name: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
assessments.format: 1-hour online proctored exam; true/false, multiple-choice and multiple-answer questions (tests Terraform 1.12)
assessments.credential: HashiCorp certification and digital badge, valid for 2 years
assessments.why: The cheapest recognised cloud-engineering certification and directly about infrastructure as code, which your resume does not show yet.

assessments.name: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer
assessments.format: 2-hour proctored exam (online or test centre), 50–60 multiple-choice and multiple-select questions
assessments.credential: Google Cloud certification and digital badge, valid for 3 years
assessments.why: Turns your Cloud Run, Artifact Registry and Cloud Storage work at Quantiphi into a recognised credential; Google recommends 6+ months of hands-on Google Cloud.

assessments.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer
assessments.format: 2-hour proctored exam (online or test centre), 50–60 multiple-choice and multiple-select questions
assessments.credential: Google Cloud professional certification and digital badge
assessments.why: The developer-focused Google Cloud certification (building and deploying applications on GCP): the strongest fit for full-stack roles on Google Cloud, after the Associate.

assessments.name: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
assessments.format: 130-minute exam, 65 multiple-choice and multiple-response questions, test centre or online proctored
assessments.credential: AWS certification and Credly badge, valid for 3 years
assessments.why: If you target AWS roles instead. The exam is being updated: registration for DVA-C03 opens on 27 October 2026, and the last day for DVA-C02 is 30 November 2026, so study for the new version if you book later.
